baseline: ed403c8 plus pending archive guard (no UI changes)
method: Fresh headless Chrome profile, 1440x900, all first-use defaults; generated 20 mm cube, 2400 triangles. Actual file picker, units dialog, canvas clicks, plane creation, dimension dropdowns, toolbar undo/redo, Save Project and Export STEP. No store mutation or API-created geometry. Expert operator following visible controls; not a human novice study.
